name: files
description: Array of file diffs. Each entry carries file_path, status (added/modified/deleted/unchanged), and optional unified_diff text for modified files.

name: leftLabel
description: Label rendered above the left (before) panel. Ignored when tierContext is provided.

name: rightLabel
description: Label rendered above the right (after) panel. Ignored when tierContext is provided.

name: onClose
description: Invoked when the user dismisses the diff viewer. Hides the close affordance when not provided.

name: showResolutionActions
description: Render the keep-local / keep-remote / merge buttons for sync-conflict resolution flows.

name: localLabel
description: Custom label for the keep-local action button.

name: remoteLabel
description: Custom label for the keep-remote action button.

name: previewMode
description: Show a preview-mode UI layer before applying a resolution.

name: isResolving
description: Disable resolution buttons and show in-flight UI while a resolution is being applied.

name: isLoading
description: Render a skeleton placeholder while diff data is being fetched.

name: tierContext
description: Optional enterprise tier metadata. When set, panel headers display tier badges instead of leftLabel/rightLabel.
